mapper.select: SELECT C.CHTRM_ID, C.CHTRM_NM, C.CHTRM_EXPLN, C.CHTRM_TYPE_CD, C.ESTBLSH_ID, C.CREAT_DT, C.END_DT, P.CHTRM_ID AS PTCPT_CHTRM_ID, P.EMP_ID, P.PTCPT_STTUS_CD, P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID, P.JOIN_DT, P.LEAV_DT FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM C JOIN TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT P ON C.CHTRM_ID = P.CHTRM_ID WHERE P.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND P.LEAV_DT IS NULL ORDER BY C.CREAT_DT DESC

SELECT C.CHTRM_ID, C.CHTRM_NM, C.CHTRM_EXPLN, C.CHTRM_TYPE_CD, C.ESTBLSH_ID, C.CREAT_DT, C.END_DT, P.CHTRM_ID AS PTCPT_CHTRM_ID, P.EMP_ID, P.PTCPT_STTUS_CD, P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID, P.JOIN_DT, P.LEAV_DT, M.MSG_ID, M.CHTRM_ID AS MSG_CHTRM_ID, M.SNDR_ID, M.MSG_CN, M.CREAT_DT AS MSG_CREAT_DT FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM C LEFT JOIN TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT P ON C.CHTRM_ID = P.CHTRM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MSNGR_MSG M ON C.CHTRM_ID = M.CHTRM_ID WHERE C.CHTRM_ID = #{chtrmId} ORDER BY M.CREAT_DT ASC
SELECT CHTRM_ID, EMP_ID, PTCPT_STTUS_CD, LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID, JOIN_DT, LEAV_DT FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT WHERE CHTRM_ID = #{chtrmId} AND LEAV_DT IS NULL
SELECT M.MSG_ID, M.CHTRM_ID, M.SNDR_ID, M.MSG_CN, M.CREAT_DT, E.EMP_NM AS SENDER_NAME FROM TB_MSNGR_MSG M JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON M.SNDR_ID = E.EMP_ID WHERE M.MSG_ID = #{msgId}
SELECT MSG_ID, CHTRM_ID, SNDR_ID, MSG_CN, CREAT_DT FROM TB_MSNGR_MSG WHERE CHTRM_ID = #{chtrmId} ORDER BY CREAT_DT ASC

INSERT INTO TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT ( CHTRM_ID, EMP_ID, PTCPT_STTUS_CD, JOIN_DT ) VALUES ( #{chtrmId}, #{empId}, #{ptcptSttusCd}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_MSG_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_MSNGR_MSG ( MSG_ID, CHTRM_ID, SNDR_ID, MSG_CN, CREAT_DT ) VALUES ( #{msgId}, #{chtrmId}, #{sndrId}, #{msgCn}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT PTCPT_STTUS_CD FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND LEAV_DT IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1
